strings/join#

Strings joined with a separator, within limits.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Joined(separator: ", ", values: names).string();      // "Ada, Grace"

let parts = JoinedParts(separator: "/", maximum_items: 64, maximum_length: 4096)
    .following("usr")
    .following("local");
parts.string();                                        // "usr/local"

Description#

Strings joined with a separator, within limits.

Without limits, Joined takes up to 10000 items and 1048576 characters. Past a limit, JoinLimitExceeded says which.

Public API#
